annotations.title: Get federal contracts by completion date (SAM.gov, recompete search)

description: Federal contract awards from SAM.gov's Contract Awards API (the FPDS successor), filtered by ultimate completion date: the contracts that are ending, which is where recompetes come from. Defaults to contracts ending in the next 180 days. Rows are collapsed to the latest action per contract. Each carries the PIID, agency, office, awardee and UEI, NAICS, PSC, competition and set-aside, dates, and contract value. Defense awards appear 90 days after signing.

completion_from.description: Ultimate completion date from, YYYY-MM-DD (default: today).

completion_to.description: Ultimate completion date to, YYYY-MM-DD (default: today + 180 days).

min_value.description: Minimum ultimate contract value (base + all options), USD.

naics.description: NAICS code, or a comma list, e.g. '541512,541511'.
